{{Top|leg}}
A '''slicers' key''' was a specialized [[Computer/Legends|computer]] chip. When installed into a host system, it allowed [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] access to it and gave them the ability to retrieve, upload or change [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]]. Slicers' keys also introduced a [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]] into a computer system that could delete all records for the previous twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="Elrood">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref>
